overview.zh: 1512 U IE2-8 是 FAULHABER 的有刷直流微型电机。采用贵金属换相结构输出旋转运动；带编码器版本提供轴位置反馈，减速版本的电机侧与输出侧参数分别列出。
overview.en: 1512 U IE2-8 is a FAULHABER brushed dc micromotor. Uses precious-metal commutation for rotary motion. Encoder versions provide shaft feedback; geared versions distinguish motor-side and output-side specifications.

value.en: Read existing ratio rows as: output speed up to, mass with motor, continuous output torque, intermittent output torque, reversible direction, efficiency. overview.zh: 2607 T 006 SR IE2-16 是 FAULHABER 的有刷直流微型电机。采用贵金属换相结构输出旋转运动；带编码器版本提供轴位置反馈，减速版本的电机侧与输出侧参数分别列出。
overview.en: 2607 T 006 SR IE2-16 is a FAULHABER brushed dc micromotor. Uses precious-metal commutation for rotary motion. Encoder versions provide shaft feedback; geared versions distinguish motor-side and output-side specifications.

overview.en: 2619 S IE2-16 is a FAULHABER brushed dc micromotor. Uses precious-metal commutation for rotary motion. Encoder versions provide shaft feedback; geared versions distinguish motor-side and output-side specifications.

overview.zh: 2619 S 012 SR IE2-16 是 FAULHABER 的有刷直流微型电机。采用贵金属换相结构输出旋转运动；带编码器版本提供轴位置反馈，减速版本的电机侧与输出侧参数分别列出。
overview.en: 2619 S 012 SR IE2-16 is a FAULHABER brushed dc micromotor. Uses precious-metal commutation for rotary motion. Encoder versions provide shaft feedback; geared versions distinguish motor-side and output-side specifications.

overview.zh: 2619 S 024 SR IE2-16 是 FAULHABER 的有刷直流微型电机。采用贵金属换相结构输出旋转运动；带编码器版本提供轴位置反馈，减速版本的电机侧与输出侧参数分别列出。
overview.en: 2619 S 024 SR IE2-16 is a FAULHABER brushed dc micromotor. Uses precious-metal commutation for rotary motion. Encoder versions provide shaft feedback; geared versions distinguish motor-side and output-side specifications.

overview.zh: 1525 U 009 BRC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 1525 U 009 BRC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 1935 S 006 BRC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 1935 S 006 BRC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 1935 S 009 BRC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 1935 S 009 BRC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 3153 K 012 BRC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 3153 K 012 BRC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 3153 K 024 BRC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 3153 K 024 BRC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 3242 G 012 BX4 SC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 3242 G 012 BX4 SC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 3242 G 012 BX4 SCDC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 3242 G 012 BX4 SCDC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 3268 G 024 BX4 SCDC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 3268 G 024 BX4 SCDC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 2610 T 006 B SC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 2610 T 006 B SC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 2622 S 006 B SC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 2622 S 006 B SC is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: 2622 S 012 B SC 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。

overview.zh: 2232 S 012 BX4 IMC ... 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 2232 S 012 BX4 IMC ... is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: 2232 S 018 BX4 IMC ... 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 2232 S 018 BX4 IMC ... is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: 2232 S 024 BX4 IMC ... 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 2232 S 024 BX4 IMC ... is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: 2250 S 012 BX4 IMC ... 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 2250 S 012 BX4 IMC ... is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: 2250 S 018 BX4 IMC ... 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。

overview.zh: 2250 S 024 BX4 IMC ... 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: 2250 S 024 BX4 IMC ... is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: MCS 3242G 012BX4 RS/CO 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: MCS 3242G 012BX4 RS/CO is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: MCS 3242G 024BX4 RS/CO 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: MCS 3242G 024BX4 RS/CO is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: MCS 3242G 012BX4 ET 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: MCS 3242G 012BX4 ET is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: MCS 3242G 024BX4 ET 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: MCS 3242G 024BX4 ET is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: MCS 3268G 024BX4 RS/CO 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: MCS 3268G 024BX4 RS/CO is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: MCS 3268G 024BX4 ET 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: MCS 3268G 024BX4 ET is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: MCS 3274G 024BP4 RS/CO 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: MCS 3274G 024BP4 RS/CO is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

overview.zh: MCS 3274G 024BP4 ET 是 FAULHABER 的集成控制无刷电机。电子换相与控制器集成在电机中，以减少外置驱动布线；速度控制和运动控制接口按具体系列区分。
overview.en: MCS 3274G 024BP4 ET is a FAULHABER brushless motor with integrated control. Integrates electronic commutation and control to reduce external drive wiring; speed-control and motion-control interfaces depend on the family.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: AM0820 0225 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM0820 0225 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM0820 0150 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。

overview.zh: AM0820 0080 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM0820 0080 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM1020 0250 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM1020 0250 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM1020 0180 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM1020 0180 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM1020 0090 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM1020 0090 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM1020 0045 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM1020 0045 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM1524 0450 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。

overview.zh: AM1524 0250 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM1524 0250 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM1524 0150 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM1524 0150 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM1524 0075 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM1524 0075 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM2224 1000 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM2224 1000 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM2224 0500 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM2224 0500 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM2224 0250 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。

overview.zh: AM2224 0125 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM2224 0125 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM2224R3 1000 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM2224R3 1000 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM2224R3 0500 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM2224R3 0500 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM2224R3 0250 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM2224R3 0250 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: AM2224R3 0125 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: AM2224R3 0125 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM0620 0130 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM0620 0130 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM0620 0080 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM0620 0080 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM0620 0040 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM0620 0040 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM1220 0330 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM1220 0330 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM1220 0220 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM1220 0220 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM1220 0110 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。

overview.zh: DM1220 0055 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM1220 0055 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM40100R 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM40100R is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM52100N 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM52100N is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

overview.zh: DM52100R 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM52100R is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: DM52100S 3300 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM52100S 3300 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: DM52100S 1300 是 FAULHABER 的步进电机。通过分相励磁实现离散步进或微步定位；保持转矩对应通电静止状态，并不等于高速运行转矩。
overview.en: DM52100S 1300 is a FAULHABER stepper motor. Uses phased excitation for full-step or microstep positioning. Holding torque refers to an energized stationary rotor, not high-speed running torque.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: LM 1247 ... 11 是 FAULHABER 的直线直流伺服电机。直接产生往复直线推力，无需把旋转运动经过丝杆转换；可选推杆行程和反馈形式必须与原表对应。

overview.zh: LM 1483 ... 12 是 FAULHABER 的直线直流伺服电机。直接产生往复直线推力，无需把旋转运动经过丝杆转换；可选推杆行程和反馈形式必须与原表对应。
overview.en: LM 1483 ... 12 is a FAULHABER linear dc servomotor. Directly produces reciprocating linear force without screw conversion. Rod stroke and feedback must match the published configuration.

overview.zh: 06/1 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 06/1 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 08/1 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 08/1 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 08/2 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。

overview.zh: 08/3 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 08/3 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 10/1 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 10/1 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 12/3 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 12/3 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 12/4 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。

overview.zh: 13A 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 13A is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 14/1 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 14/1 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: 15A 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。

overview.zh: 15/5 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 15/5 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 15/8 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 15/8 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 16A 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 16A is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 16/5 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 16/5 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 16/7 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 16/7 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 16/8 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。

overview.zh: 22E 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 22E is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: 22EKV 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 22EKV is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: 22/2 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 22/2 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: 23/1 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 23/1 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 30/1 S 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 30/1 S is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: 32/3R 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 32/3R is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 38/2 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 38/2 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 14GPT 166:1 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 14GPT 166:1 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。

overview.zh: 20GPT 313:1 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 20GPT 313:1 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 32GPT 178:1 是 FAULHABER 的精密减速器。以齿轮传动降低电机转速并增加输出转矩；级数、速比和轴承配置决定效率、回差及允许载荷。
overview.en: 32GPT 178:1 is a FAULHABER precision gearhead. Reduces motor speed and increases output torque through gearing. Stage count, ratio and bearing configuration determine efficiency, backlash and permissible loads.

overview.zh: 10L ... SL 是 FAULHABER 的丝杆直线传动件。利用丝杆或集成减速丝杆将电机旋转转换为直线进给，适合定位、调节和推力任务。
overview.en: 10L ... SL is a FAULHABER lead-screw linear transmission. Converts motor rotation into linear feed using a lead screw or geared screw for positioning, adjustment and thrust tasks.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: 22L ... SB 是 FAULHABER 的丝杆直线传动件。利用丝杆或集成减速丝杆将电机旋转转换为直线进给，适合定位、调节和推力任务。

overview.zh: IE2-400 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE2-400 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IE2-256 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE2-256 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEH2-16 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEH2-16 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IEH2-512 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEH2-512 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.en: HEDS 5500 C is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: HXM3-64 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: HXM3-64 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

verification.zh: 保留原表工况和原始文档定位；多配置列表及静态、峰值、选件值不冒充连续额定值。
verification.en: Retains source conditions and locators. Multiple-configuration lists, static, peak and option values are not treated as continuous ratings.

overview.zh: IEM3-128 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEM3-128 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEM3-256 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEM3-256 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IE3-32 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-32 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IE3-64 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-64 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IE3-128 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-128 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IE3-256 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-256 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IE3-512 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-512 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: IE3-1024 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-1024 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IE3-64 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-64 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IE3-128 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-128 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IE3-256 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-256 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IE3-512 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IE3-512 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEF3-32 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-32 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: IEF3-64 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-64 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEF3-128 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-128 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IEF3-256 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-256 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEF3-512 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-512 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEF3-1024 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-1024 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: IEF3-2048 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-2048 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEF3-4096 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-4096 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: IEF3-64 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-64 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

verification.zh: 保留原表工况和原始文档定位；多配置列表及静态、峰值、选件值不冒充连续额定值。

overview.zh: IEF3-128 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-128 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: IEF3-1024 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-1024 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IEF3-2048 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEF3-2048 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEH3-512 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEH3-512 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: IEH3-4096 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEH3-4096 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEH3-1024L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEH3-1024L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IEH3-2048L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEH3-2048L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IEH3-4096L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEH3-4096L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEP3-16 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-16 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEP3-32 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-32 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEP3-64 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-64 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEP3-128 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-128 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEP3-256 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-256 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEP3-512 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-512 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEP3-1024 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-1024 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEP3-2048 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-2048 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEP3-4096 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEP3-4096 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEX3-16 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-16 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: IEX3-32 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-32 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEX3-64 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-64 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: IEX3-128 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-128 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEX3-256 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-256 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEX3-512 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-512 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEX3-1024 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-1024 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEX3-2048 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-2048 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEX3-32L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-32L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IEX3-64L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-64L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.en: IEX3-128L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IEX3-1024L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-1024L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IEX3-2048L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IEX3-2048L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IERS3-500 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IERS3-500 is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

overview.zh: IERS3-250 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IERS3-250 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

overview.zh: IERS3-500 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IERS3-500 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IERF3-2048 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IERF3-2048 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: IERF3-4096 L 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: IERF3-4096 L is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

overview.zh: HEDL 5540 A 是 FAULHABER 的位置编码器。提供转轴位移与运动反馈，用于闭环位置和速度控制；增量、绝对值、线驱动和协议能力按原型号区分。
overview.en: HEDL 5540 A is a FAULHABER position encoder. Supplies shaft displacement and motion feedback for closed-loop position and speed control. Incremental, absolute, line-driver and protocol capabilities depend on the model.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成

value.en: A disturbance-voltage test with a resistive load can qualitatively assess the supply; connection to a DC network assumes negligible supply switching interference, which a linear supply can reduce.

value.en: Passing all motor phases through a common-mode choke/ferrite ring removes motor RF common-mode interference and enables quick testing; it does not remove all interference and requires fabrication.

value.en: The manual warns of danger to life from ground leakage currents >=3.5 mA and requires checking device grounding.

label.zh: EMC / 保护接地与等电位要求

value.zh: 优先采用星形或网状接地，保证截面及低接触电阻；必要时清除端部氧化层。电源、电机、控制器等需要接地的部件使用独立 PE，并尽量缩短接地线。
value.en: Prefer star or mesh grounding with adequate cross-section and low contact resistance; remove terminal oxide when needed. Use separate PE conductors for parts requiring grounding, including supply, motor and controller, and keep earth leads short.

value.zh: 使用紧密编织屏蔽层，优先直接、大面积接触接地板，避免先经控制器再到接地板。
value.en: Use tightly meshed braid and prefer direct large-area contact with the ground plate, avoiding a route through the controller first.

label.zh: EMC / 布线防触电条件

value.zh: 驱动系统内可能产生并传输 >25 VAC；布线须防触及，且仅在 SELV 或 PELV 电源网络上运行。
value.en: Voltages >25 VAC are generated and transmitted in the drive system; wiring must be touch-proof and operation limited to an SELV or PELV supply network.

value.zh: 优先使用连续表面的 U 形金属线槽，沿角部走线并按功能分组和保持距离；相关线缆尽量双绞或按功能组绞合屏蔽。图 32：1 电机供电、2 数字控制信号、3 传感器线。

value.en: Only in special cases or after qualification may shielding be omitted for cables <50 cm, low-supply cables (example <20 V), or sensor cables.

value.en: Connect shield clamps to a low-impedance (<0.3 ohm) grounding bar or plate and use star-point earthing.

label.zh: 图 34 / 分离与外层屏蔽连接条件

value.zh: 电机相线屏蔽须与传感器/编码器信号分开，至少在电机侧连接；共用线缆时可另加外层编织屏蔽，并在两端连接。若接地电位差妨碍连接，可用适配的安全电容（示例 Y1/Y2/X1/X2）建立 RF 连接；除电机和控制器端外不要多点连接。
value.en: Separate motor-phase shielding from sensor/encoder signals and connect at least at the motor. A shared cable may add an outer braid connected at both ends. Where ground offset prevents this, suitable safety capacitors (examples Y1/Y2/X1/X2) may establish RF connection; avoid extra shield connections beyond motor and controller ends.

label.zh: 图 35 / 线缆屏蔽端接工序

value.zh: 剥除外层约 50-100 mm，勿损伤编织线；将编织层推回或卷起并用热缩管固定；端头可选压接套管后接插头。图例 1 外层、2 编织屏蔽、3 屏蔽夹、4 热缩管、5 压接套管；步骤末尾称用扎带固定屏蔽与热缩管。
value.en: Remove approximately 50-100 mm of outer covering without damaging the braid; push back or roll the braid and secure with heat-shrink tubing; optionally fit crimp sleeves before the connector. Legend: 1 outer layer, 2 braid, 3 shield clamp, 4 heat-shrink, 5 crimp sleeve; the final step says to secure shield and tubing with a cable tie.

label.en: Figure 36 / Cable-lug shield connection when unavoidable

value.zh: 尽量避免线鼻屏蔽连接；必要时清除孔周氧化层，螺钉与垫圈穿过线鼻，装锁紧垫圈，按螺钉长度使其接触粗化表面，再用底侧螺母或螺纹固定。图例 1 螺钉、2 螺母、3 弹簧垫圈、4 平垫圈、5 锁紧垫圈、6 壁板、7 线眼、8 保护导体。
value.en: Avoid cable-lug shielding where possible. When necessary, remove oxide around the hole, pass screw and washers through the lug, add a lock washer against the roughened surface as screw length permits, then fasten using a lower nut or thread. Legend: 1 screw, 2 nut, 3 spring washer, 4 washer, 5 lock washer, 6 wall, 7 wire eyelet, 8 protective conductor.

label.zh: EMC / 传感器信号验证与长线抗扰
label.en: EMC / Sensor-signal verification and long-line immunity

value.zh: 实际测量传输信号质量，选择正确参考电位并尽可能直接在控制器处测量以避免寄生测量影响；较长线缆可用差分线路驱动提高抗扰度。
value.en: Measure signal transmission quality, choose the correct reference potential and measure directly at the controller where possible to avoid parasitic measurement effects; differential line drivers can improve immunity over longer cables.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. No new permissible cable length; retain the existing sensor-specific length conditions.

label.zh: EMC / 模拟传感器滤波电容条件

value.zh: 尽量屏蔽模拟传感器线并与电机线分开，屏蔽单端连接且优先电机侧；设备屏蔽与传感器 +5 V 电源间可用 470 nF、耐压 >100 V 的电容改善信号质量。
value.en: Where possible, shield analog sensor cables separately from motor cables and connect the shield at one end, preferably the motor; a 470 nF capacitor with dielectric strength >100 V between device shield and sensor +5 V supply can improve signal quality.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Optional immunity measure; >100 V is capacitor dielectric strength, not sensor input voltage.

label.zh: EMC / 数字反馈抗扰说明

value.zh: 手册将数字霍尔较强抗扰性归因于更大的信号迟滞，将增量编码器的抗扰性归因于控制器四边沿评估。
value.en: The manual attributes digital Hall robustness to increased signal hysteresis and incremental-encoder robustness to four-edge evaluation in the controller.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Manufacturer qualitative explanation; no immunity class or resolution gain quantified.

label.zh: EMC / 绝对编码器终端配置

value.zh: 编码器屏蔽两端连接；控制器侧靠近编码器插头处，强烈建议在 Data+ 与 Data- 间接 120 ohm。部分母板版本已提供终端，可由 DIP 开关 S2 启用。
value.en: Connect encoder shielding at both ends; near the controller encoder connector, 120 ohm between Data+ and Data- is strongly recommended. Some motherboard versions provide termination enabled by DIP switch S2.

label.zh: EMC / 绝对编码器分裂终端选项

value.zh: 可用分裂终端替代 120 ohm 以提高抗扰性，详见 AEMTL 手册 7000.0x070；绝对接口受干扰时会立即产生无效位置值，因此差分传输有利。
value.en: Split termination may replace 120 ohm to improve immunity; refer to AEMTL manual 7000.0x070. Interference on an absolute interface immediately yields invalid position values, making differential transmission advantageous.

label.zh: EMC / 滤波器类别与示意标识
label.en: EMC / Filter categories and schematic identity

value.zh: 输入侧滤波器位于电源侧；电机侧滤波器连接在控制器与电机相线之间。图 38 标注 EFS 3004、6501.00367；被动滤波布局设计信息需向厂家索取。
value.en: Input filters sit on the supply side; motor filters sit between controller and motor phases. Figure 38 identifies EFS 3004, 6501.00367; passive-filter layout/design details are available on request.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. No component values in the schematic and no new filter variant created; on-request details are not treated as fully public.

label.zh: 图 39 / 带母板的低阻抗接地安装

value.zh: 每条线缆屏蔽通过屏蔽夹低阻抗接地；PCB 螺钉连接处金属化也须低阻抗接地，如接导电底板。图 39 标号：1 控制器 PCB、2 母板、3 顶帽式导轨外壳、4 电机侧滤波器、5 被遮挡的输入侧滤波器。
value.en: Earth every cable shield through a low-impedance shield clamp and earth PCB screw-hole metallization with low impedance, for example via a conductive baseplate. Figure 39: 1 controller PCB, 2 motherboard, 3 top-hat-rail housing, 4 motor filter, 5 covered input filter.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Installation example; these accessories are not implied to be included with any B/P controller.

label.zh: EMC / 外置 PWM 滤波器适用条件

value.zh: 设备内已有接近 PWM 滤波效果的措施，外置 PWM 滤波器通常仅在例外情况下需要。
value.en: Internal measures approach PWM-filter behavior, so an external PWM filter is needed only in exceptional cases.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Neither prohibits an external filter nor guarantees that every application needs none.

label.zh: EMC / 母板铁氧体滤波器表述

value.zh: 手册称母板具有类似形式和作用的滤波器，并写明它们“降低电机电压/电流上升时间”从而降低屏蔽上的高频耦合电流。
value.en: The manual says similar filters are present on motherboards and describes them as reducing motor-voltage/current rise time and thereby high-frequency coupling currents on the shield.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.zh: MC 3001 P 现有标准系列记录；手册第 5 版，2025-04-23。安装、配置、维护或声明条件，非无条件额定值。按来源保留 rise time 的原文方向，不自行改写为上升沿变慢或量化其数值。
conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Preserve the source direction for rise time; do not silently rewrite it as a slower edge or assign a value.

label.zh: EMC / 附加输入滤波器适用条件

value.zh: 母板已有接近抑制干扰效果的措施；附加输入滤波器 6501.00367 通常仅在环境有特殊抗扰要求或辐射干扰明显时需要。
value.en: Motherboard measures already approach the interference-reducing effect; an additional input filter 6501.00367 is usually needed only for special ambient immunity requirements or noticeable emissions.

label.zh: EMC / 输入滤波措施与电容示例
label.en: EMC / Input-filter measures and capacitance example

value.zh: 无法使用电机滤波或其效果不足时，采用靠近控制器的较大、尽可能低 ESR 电容（原文约 >100 uF），以及共模扼流圈、低通和功能地至 DC 电源间电容抑制共模干扰。
value.en: Where motor filtering cannot be used or is insufficient, use a large, preferably low-ESR capacitance near the controller (source wording approximately >100 uF), plus a common-mode choke, low-pass filter and capacitors between functional earth and DC supply.

Retains approximation and strict greater-than; not a built-in controller capacitance rating or complete design value.

label.zh: EMC / 滤波器绝缘电阻测试限制

value.zh: FAULHABER 滤波器不用于绝缘电阻测试；共模抑制电容放电通路使该测试无法得到有意义的结果。
value.en: FAULHABER filters are not intended for an insulation-resistance test; common-mode suppression capacitors prevent a meaningful result.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Filter test limitation, not an inferred controller insulation class or withstand voltage.

label.zh: EMC / 共绕磁环推荐范围

value.zh: 优选在 1-10 MHz 范围有效的锰锌铁氧体，典型直径 25-35 mm；所有电机相线同时绕 2-3 匝。
value.en: Prefer manganese-zinc ferrite active at 1-10 MHz with typical diameter 25-35 mm; wind all motor phases together for 2-3 turns.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Immunity installation guide, not motor frequency, controller dimensions or a fixed supplied-accessory specification.

label.zh: 图 40 / 磁环三匝工序示例

value.zh: 先固定相线，电机端背离操作者、插头端朝向操作者；全部相线从下方共同穿环，顺时针绕成首匝后再绕 2 匝，环中得到 9 段绞线，最后固定。图标 1 为相线固定点，2 为可选磁环固定点。
value.en: Secure phase cables with motor ends away and connector ends toward the operator; pass all phases together from below, form the first clockwise turn and add 2 more turns, giving 9 stranded-wire passages, then secure. Callout 1 fastens phase cables; 2 is optional fastening on the ring.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. This worked procedure uses three turns; retain the separate 2-3 turn guide rather than turn both into a fixed rating.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 干扰源与连接核验
label.en: EMC troubleshooting / Source and connection checks

value.zh: 厂家建议检查故障是否来自驱动：切换输出级（可用电压控制模式）、断开供电或用独立测试电源、关闭不必要部件；核验均匀地电位、金属接触、屏蔽以及插接/螺接是否正确。
value.en: Manufacturer troubleshooting checks whether the drive causes the problem: switch the output stage (voltage-control mode is suitable), disconnect supply or use a dedicated test supply, and disable unnecessary components; verify uniform ground potential, metal contact, shielding and secure plug/screw connections.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.zh: MC 3001 P 现有标准系列记录；手册第 5 版，2025-04-23。安装、配置、维护或声明条件，非无条件额定值。仅记录由合格人员执行的排查流程；不是自动恢复或安全停止能力。
conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Records qualified-person troubleshooting only; not automatic recovery or a safety-stop capability.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 电机线的双屏蔽选项

value.zh: 使用附件目录推荐的屏蔽电机线，以免线缆像天线一样产生干扰；有疑问时可加倍屏蔽并参考附件目录及屏蔽章节。
value.en: Use shielded motor cables recommended in the accessory catalog to avoid antenna-like interference; if uncertain, shielding can be doubled with reference to the accessory catalog and shielding section.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.zh: MC 3001 P 现有标准系列记录；手册第 5 版，2025-04-23。安装、配置、维护或声明条件，非无条件额定值。加倍屏蔽是条件性选项，不是所有线缆强制双层。
conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Double shielding is conditional, not a universal two-layer requirement.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 编码器与电机线间距

value.zh: 编码器连接线与电机连接线保持至少 10 cm。
value.en: Keep encoder connection cables at least 10 cm from motor connection cables.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.zh: MC 3001 P 现有标准系列记录；手册第 5 版，2025-04-23。安装、配置、维护或声明条件，非无条件额定值。故障排查章节条件，独立于图 33 的 >5 cm 示例。
conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Troubleshooting condition, separate from the >5 cm example in Figure 33.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 传感器与其他信号线间距

value.zh: 传感器线与所有非传感器信号线保持至少 10 cm；尽量使用带线路驱动的增量编码器。
value.en: Keep sensor cables at least 10 cm from all non-sensor signal cables; use incremental encoders with line drivers where possible.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.zh: MC 3001 P 现有标准系列记录；手册第 5 版，2025-04-23。安装、配置、维护或声明条件，非无条件额定值。不是传感器线彼此之间的统一间距要求。
conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Not a universal spacing requirement between sensor cables themselves.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 交叉角度与滤波触发
label.en: EMC troubleshooting / Crossing angle and filter trigger

value.zh: 远离高压电流及市电线，交叉仅采用 90 度；信号质量差或存在/预期存在干扰时采用滤波器。
value.en: Keep clear of high-voltage-current and mains cables, cross cables only at 90 degrees, and use filters when signal quality is poor or interference occurs or is expected.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Routing geometry and application conditions, not a mechanical angle or joint range.

label.zh: EMC 测量 / 传导干扰布线条件

value.zh: 消除线缆环路，采用蛇形走线；电机屏蔽在电机端和靠近控制器端大面积、优先圆周连接；使用输入滤波器，尽量用屏蔽夹或胶带固定线缆。
value.en: Remove cable loops and use meandering routing; connect motor shielding at the motor and close to the controller over a large, preferably round contact; use input filters and secure cables with shield clamps or tape where possible.

value.zh: 选择输入滤波器时，注意 50 ohm 测量与更实际的 1/100 ohm 或 100/1 ohm 测量工况下滤波衰减的差异。
value.en: When selecting an input filter, distinguish attenuation measured at 50 ohm from more realistic 1/100 ohm or 100/1 ohm measurement conditions.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Retain the paired impedance notation; do not simplify 1/100 or 100/1 into a single resistance.

label.zh: EMC 测量 / 辐射干扰布线条件

value.zh: 尽量将连接线铺在接地板上，屏蔽连接及未屏蔽线尽量短；使用 EMC 滤波器并尽量缩短连接。
value.en: Where possible lay connection cables over a ground plate, minimize shield-connection and unshielded-cable lengths, and use an EMC filter with the shortest practicable connection.

label.zh: 安装 / 人员与文件要求

value.zh: 仅由熟悉自动化、适用标准法规、EMC、低压和机械指令、DIN VDE 0100 及事故预防的受训专业人员或经指导人员安装调试；须阅读并遵守手册及第 2.3 章补充安装说明。
value.en: Installation and commissioning are for trained experts or instructed personnel familiar with automation, applicable standards, EMC, Low Voltage and Machinery Directives, DIN VDE 0100 and accident prevention; read and follow the manual and supplementary section 2.3.

label.zh: 安装 / 热表面与失控运动防护

value.zh: 控制器可能很热，应在其近旁设置防触护罩和警示；损坏或安装不当可导致意外启动、停止或卡滞，须遵守安全章节并使用合适紧固材料。
value.en: The controller may become hot; place a contact guard and warning nearby. Damage or improper installation can cause unexpected start, stop or jamming; follow the safety chapter and use suitable fastening material.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Distinct from the stored page 73 moving-part guard: this concerns controller heat and assembly risk.

label.zh: 安装 / 开箱外观检查项目

value.zh: 开箱后检查并记录：控制器无损、序列号贴纸存在、连接器针脚无氧化或弯曲。
value.en: After unpacking, inspect and document an undamaged controller, presence of the serial-number sticker, and connector pins free of oxidation or bending.

conditions.en: MC 3001 P existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Adds checklist items; the existing page 73 startup prohibition after a failed inspection remains unchanged.

label.en: Maintenance / General maintenance-free and cabinet-filter conditions

value.zh: 驱动通常免维护；安装在机柜中时，应按积尘情况定期检查空气过滤器，必要时清洁。
value.en: The drive is generally maintenance-free; when cabinet-mounted, regularly inspect the air filter according to dust accumulation and clean when necessary.

value.zh: 在预期用途内运行仍出现意外故障时，联系支持伙伴。
value.en: Contact the support partner for unexpected malfunctions during intended-use operation.

label.zh: EMC / 保护接地与等电位要求

value.zh: 优先采用星形或网状接地，保证截面及低接触电阻；必要时清除端部氧化层。电源、电机、控制器等需要接地的部件使用独立 PE，并尽量缩短接地线。
value.en: Prefer star or mesh grounding with adequate cross-section and low contact resistance; remove terminal oxide when needed. Use separate PE conductors for parts requiring grounding, including supply, motor and controller, and keep earth leads short.

value.zh: 使用紧密编织屏蔽层，优先直接、大面积接触接地板，避免先经控制器再到接地板。
value.en: Use tightly meshed braid and prefer direct large-area contact with the ground plate, avoiding a route through the controller first.

value.zh: 驱动系统内可能产生并传输 >25 VAC；布线须防触及，且仅在 SELV 或 PELV 电源网络上运行。
value.en: Voltages >25 VAC are generated and transmitted in the drive system; wiring must be touch-proof and operation limited to an SELV or PELV supply network.

label.zh: EMC / 线槽分组布线

value.zh: 优先使用连续表面的 U 形金属线槽，沿角部走线并按功能分组和保持距离；相关线缆尽量双绞或按功能组绞合屏蔽。图 32：1 电机供电、2 数字控制信号、3 传感器线。
value.en: Prefer a continuous-surface U-shaped metal duct, route near corners, separate by function and maintain spacing; use twisted pairs or function-group twisting/shielding where possible. Figure 32: 1 motor supplies, 2 digital control signals, 3 sensor cables.

value.en: Shield connection cables; use tightly meshed copper braid for cables >3 m. Shield supply lines according to applicable requirements and connect with a round shield clamp.

label.zh: 图 34 / 分离与外层屏蔽连接条件

value.zh: 电机相线屏蔽须与传感器/编码器信号分开，至少在电机侧连接；共用线缆时可另加外层编织屏蔽，并在两端连接。若接地电位差妨碍连接，可用适配的安全电容（示例 Y1/Y2/X1/X2）建立 RF 连接；除电机和控制器端外不要多点连接。
value.en: Separate motor-phase shielding from sensor/encoder signals and connect at least at the motor. A shared cable may add an outer braid connected at both ends. Where ground offset prevents this, suitable safety capacitors (examples Y1/Y2/X1/X2) may establish RF connection; avoid extra shield connections beyond motor and controller ends.

label.zh: 图 35 / 线缆屏蔽端接工序

value.zh: 剥除外层约 50-100 mm，勿损伤编织线；将编织层推回或卷起并用热缩管固定；端头可选压接套管后接插头。图例 1 外层、2 编织屏蔽、3 屏蔽夹、4 热缩管、5 压接套管；步骤末尾称用扎带固定屏蔽与热缩管。
value.en: Remove approximately 50-100 mm of outer covering without damaging the braid; push back or roll the braid and secure with heat-shrink tubing; optionally fit crimp sleeves before the connector. Legend: 1 outer layer, 2 braid, 3 shield clamp, 4 heat-shrink, 5 crimp sleeve; the final step says to secure shield and tubing with a cable tie.

label.zh: 图 36 / 必要时的线鼻屏蔽连接
label.en: Figure 36 / Cable-lug shield connection when unavoidable

value.zh: 尽量避免线鼻屏蔽连接；必要时清除孔周氧化层，螺钉与垫圈穿过线鼻，装锁紧垫圈，按螺钉长度使其接触粗化表面，再用底侧螺母或螺纹固定。图例 1 螺钉、2 螺母、3 弹簧垫圈、4 平垫圈、5 锁紧垫圈、6 壁板、7 线眼、8 保护导体。
value.en: Avoid cable-lug shielding where possible. When necessary, remove oxide around the hole, pass screw and washers through the lug, add a lock washer against the roughened surface as screw length permits, then fasten using a lower nut or thread. Legend: 1 screw, 2 nut, 3 spring washer, 4 washer, 5 lock washer, 6 wall, 7 wire eyelet, 8 protective conductor.

label.zh: EMC / 传感器信号验证与长线抗扰
label.en: EMC / Sensor-signal verification and long-line immunity

value.zh: 实际测量传输信号质量，选择正确参考电位并尽可能直接在控制器处测量以避免寄生测量影响；较长线缆可用差分线路驱动提高抗扰度。
value.en: Measure signal transmission quality, choose the correct reference potential and measure directly at the controller where possible to avoid parasitic measurement effects; differential line drivers can improve immunity over longer cables.

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. No new permissible cable length; retain the existing sensor-specific length conditions.

label.zh: EMC / 模拟传感器滤波电容条件

value.zh: 尽量屏蔽模拟传感器线并与电机线分开，屏蔽单端连接且优先电机侧；设备屏蔽与传感器 +5 V 电源间可用 470 nF、耐压 >100 V 的电容改善信号质量。
value.en: Where possible, shield analog sensor cables separately from motor cables and connect the shield at one end, preferably the motor; a 470 nF capacitor with dielectric strength >100 V between device shield and sensor +5 V supply can improve signal quality.

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Optional immunity measure; >100 V is capacitor dielectric strength, not sensor input voltage.

label.zh: EMC / 数字反馈抗扰说明

value.zh: 手册将数字霍尔较强抗扰性归因于更大的信号迟滞，将增量编码器的抗扰性归因于控制器四边沿评估。
value.en: The manual attributes digital Hall robustness to increased signal hysteresis and incremental-encoder robustness to four-edge evaluation in the controller.

label.zh: EMC / 绝对编码器终端配置

value.zh: 编码器屏蔽两端连接；控制器侧靠近编码器插头处，强烈建议在 Data+ 与 Data- 间接 120 ohm。部分母板版本已提供终端，可由 DIP 开关 S2 启用。
value.en: Connect encoder shielding at both ends; near the controller encoder connector, 120 ohm between Data+ and Data- is strongly recommended. Some motherboard versions provide termination enabled by DIP switch S2.

label.zh: EMC / 绝对编码器分裂终端选项

value.zh: 可用分裂终端替代 120 ohm 以提高抗扰性，详见 AEMTL 手册 7000.0x070；绝对接口受干扰时会立即产生无效位置值，因此差分传输有利。
value.en: Split termination may replace 120 ohm to improve immunity; refer to AEMTL manual 7000.0x070. Interference on an absolute interface immediately yields invalid position values, making differential transmission advantageous.

label.en: EMC / Filter categories and schematic identity

value.zh: 输入侧滤波器位于电源侧；电机侧滤波器连接在控制器与电机相线之间。图 38 标注 EFS 3004、6501.00367；被动滤波布局设计信息需向厂家索取。
value.en: Input filters sit on the supply side; motor filters sit between controller and motor phases. Figure 38 identifies EFS 3004, 6501.00367; passive-filter layout/design details are available on request.

label.zh: 图 39 / 带母板的低阻抗接地安装

value.zh: 每条线缆屏蔽通过屏蔽夹低阻抗接地；PCB 螺钉连接处金属化也须低阻抗接地，如接导电底板。图 39 标号：1 控制器 PCB、2 母板、3 顶帽式导轨外壳、4 电机侧滤波器、5 被遮挡的输入侧滤波器。
value.en: Earth every cable shield through a low-impedance shield clamp and earth PCB screw-hole metallization with low impedance, for example via a conductive baseplate. Figure 39: 1 controller PCB, 2 motherboard, 3 top-hat-rail housing, 4 motor filter, 5 covered input filter.
