value.zh: 设备内已有接近 PWM 滤波效果的措施，外置 PWM 滤波器通常仅在例外情况下需要。
value.en: Internal measures approach PWM-filter behavior, so an external PWM filter is needed only in exceptional cases.

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Neither prohibits an external filter nor guarantees that every application needs none.

label.zh: EMC / 母板铁氧体滤波器表述

value.zh: 手册称母板具有类似形式和作用的滤波器，并写明它们“降低电机电压/电流上升时间”从而降低屏蔽上的高频耦合电流。
value.en: The manual says similar filters are present on motherboards and describes them as reducing motor-voltage/current rise time and thereby high-frequency coupling currents on the shield.

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Preserve the source direction for rise time; do not silently rewrite it as a slower edge or assign a value.

label.zh: EMC / 附加输入滤波器适用条件

value.zh: 母板已有接近抑制干扰效果的措施；附加输入滤波器 6501.00367 通常仅在环境有特殊抗扰要求或辐射干扰明显时需要。
value.en: Motherboard measures already approach the interference-reducing effect; an additional input filter 6501.00367 is usually needed only for special ambient immunity requirements or noticeable emissions.

label.zh: EMC / 输入滤波措施与电容示例
label.en: EMC / Input-filter measures and capacitance example

value.zh: 无法使用电机滤波或其效果不足时，采用靠近控制器的较大、尽可能低 ESR 电容（原文约 >100 uF），以及共模扼流圈、低通和功能地至 DC 电源间电容抑制共模干扰。
value.en: Where motor filtering cannot be used or is insufficient, use a large, preferably low-ESR capacitance near the controller (source wording approximately >100 uF), plus a common-mode choke, low-pass filter and capacitors between functional earth and DC supply.

value.zh: FAULHABER 滤波器不用于绝缘电阻测试；共模抑制电容放电通路使该测试无法得到有意义的结果。
value.en: FAULHABER filters are not intended for an insulation-resistance test; common-mode suppression capacitors prevent a meaningful result.

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Filter test limitation, not an inferred controller insulation class or withstand voltage.

label.zh: EMC / 共绕磁环推荐范围

value.zh: 优选在 1-10 MHz 范围有效的锰锌铁氧体，典型直径 25-35 mm；所有电机相线同时绕 2-3 匝。
value.en: Prefer manganese-zinc ferrite active at 1-10 MHz with typical diameter 25-35 mm; wind all motor phases together for 2-3 turns.

label.zh: 图 40 / 磁环三匝工序示例

value.zh: 先固定相线，电机端背离操作者、插头端朝向操作者；全部相线从下方共同穿环，顺时针绕成首匝后再绕 2 匝，环中得到 9 段绞线，最后固定。图标 1 为相线固定点，2 为可选磁环固定点。
value.en: Secure phase cables with motor ends away and connector ends toward the operator; pass all phases together from below, form the first clockwise turn and add 2 more turns, giving 9 stranded-wire passages, then secure. Callout 1 fastens phase cables; 2 is optional fastening on the ring.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 干扰源与连接核验
label.en: EMC troubleshooting / Source and connection checks

value.zh: 厂家建议检查故障是否来自驱动：切换输出级（可用电压控制模式）、断开供电或用独立测试电源、关闭不必要部件；核验均匀地电位、金属接触、屏蔽以及插接/螺接是否正确。
value.en: Manufacturer troubleshooting checks whether the drive causes the problem: switch the output stage (voltage-control mode is suitable), disconnect supply or use a dedicated test supply, and disable unnecessary components; verify uniform ground potential, metal contact, shielding and secure plug/screw connections.

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Records qualified-person troubleshooting only; not automatic recovery or a safety-stop capability.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 电机线的双屏蔽选项

value.zh: 使用附件目录推荐的屏蔽电机线，以免线缆像天线一样产生干扰；有疑问时可加倍屏蔽并参考附件目录及屏蔽章节。
value.en: Use shielded motor cables recommended in the accessory catalog to avoid antenna-like interference; if uncertain, shielding can be doubled with reference to the accessory catalog and shielding section.

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Double shielding is conditional, not a universal two-layer requirement.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 编码器与电机线间距

value.zh: 编码器连接线与电机连接线保持至少 10 cm。
value.en: Keep encoder connection cables at least 10 cm from motor connection cables.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Troubleshooting condition, separate from the >5 cm example in Figure 33.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 传感器与其他信号线间距

value.zh: 传感器线与所有非传感器信号线保持至少 10 cm；尽量使用带线路驱动的增量编码器。
value.en: Keep sensor cables at least 10 cm from all non-sensor signal cables; use incremental encoders with line drivers where possible.

sourceLabel.zh: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P 官方技术手册（第 5 版）
sourceLabel.en: FAULHABER MC 3001 B/P official technical manual (fifth edition)

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Not a universal spacing requirement between sensor cables themselves.

label.zh: EMC 排查 / 交叉角度与滤波触发
label.en: EMC troubleshooting / Crossing angle and filter trigger

value.zh: 远离高压电流及市电线，交叉仅采用 90 度；信号质量差或存在/预期存在干扰时采用滤波器。
value.en: Keep clear of high-voltage-current and mains cables, cross cables only at 90 degrees, and use filters when signal quality is poor or interference occurs or is expected.

conditions.en: MC 3001 B existing standard-family record; manual fifth edition 2025-04-23. Installation, configuration, maintenance or declaration conditions, not unconditional ratings. Routing geometry and application conditions, not a mechanical angle or joint range.

label.zh: EMC 测量 / 传导干扰布线条件

value.zh: 消除线缆环路，采用蛇形走线；电机屏蔽在电机端和靠近控制器端大面积、优先圆周连接；使用输入滤波器，尽量用屏蔽夹或胶带固定线缆。
value.en: Remove cable loops and use meandering routing; connect motor shielding at the motor and close to the controller over a large, preferably round contact; use input filters and secure cables with shield clamps or tape where possible.

value.en: When selecting an input filter, distinguish attenuation measured at 50 ohm from more realistic 1/100 ohm or 100/1 ohm measurement conditions.

label.zh: EMC 测量 / 辐射干扰布线条件

value.zh: 尽量将连接线铺在接地板上，屏蔽连接及未屏蔽线尽量短；使用 EMC 滤波器并尽量缩短连接。
value.en: Where possible lay connection cables over a ground plate, minimize shield-connection and unshielded-cable lengths, and use an EMC filter with the shortest practicable connection.

value.zh: 控制器可能很热，应在其近旁设置防触护罩和警示；损坏或安装不当可导致意外启动、停止或卡滞，须遵守安全章节并使用合适紧固材料。
value.en: The controller may become hot; place a contact guard and warning nearby. Damage or improper installation can cause unexpected start, stop or jamming; follow the safety chapter and use suitable fastening material.

value.zh: 制动能量可回馈直流网络；若其他驱动不能吸收，网络电压会上升。可在控制器中设定回馈电压限值，或用额外外部制动斩波器耗散过电压。
value.en: Braking can return energy to the DC network; if other drives cannot absorb it, network voltage rises. A regenerative voltage limit can be set in the controller, or an additional external braking chopper can dissipate the overvoltage.

label.en: Installation/EMC / High-frequency interference and residential conditions

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 图36干扰路径及符号
label.en: Installation/EMC / Figure 36 interference paths and symbols

value.zh: 图36依次示出带线路滤波的 AC/DC 电源、DC 滤波器、DC/AC 控制器、电机滤波器和电机，寄生电容支路向参考地泄放电流。Z_N 为变压器至电源连接的电网阻抗；Z_E1 为电子装置直流侧共模阻抗；Z_E2 为交流侧至电源连接共模阻抗；Z_M1 为电机壳体至控制器阻抗；I_S 为寄生电流，C_P 为寄生/滤波电容。
value.en: Figure 36 shows the line-filtered AC/DC supply, DC filter, DC/AC controller, motor filter and motor, with parasitic-capacitance paths returning current to the reference ground. Z_N is mains-transformer-to-supply impedance; Z_E1 is DC-side electronics common-mode impedance; Z_E2 is AC-side-to-supply common-mode impedance; Z_M1 is motor-housing-to-controller impedance; I_S is parasitic current and C_P parasitic/filter capacitance.

label.en: Installation/EMC / PWM and power-supply interference sources

value.zh: PWM 驱动的半导体、电机电缆电容成分及电机寄生元件会产生寄生电流。手册称内部 DC-DC 开关功率 <5 W，通常相关干扰较小；外部开关电源及 PWM 驱动的干扰仍取决于设计、质量与滤波效果。
value.en: PWM semiconductors, capacitive motor-cable elements and motor parasitics generate parasitic current. The manual describes internal DC-DC switched power <5 W as normally of little interference relevance; external switching-supply and PWM-drive interference still depends on design, quality and filtering.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 接地拓扑、接触与保护导体
label.en: Installation/EMC / Ground topology, contacts and protective conductors

value.zh: 接地系统宜采用星形或网状，星形较易实现；导体截面积和接触质量须兼顾高频，必要时清除端部氧化层。按适用标准接地，为电源、电机、控制器等需要的部分分别设置 PE，并尽量缩短接地线。
value.en: Prefer star or mesh grounding, with star easier to implement; conductor cross-section and contact quality must suit high frequencies, removing terminal oxide when necessary. Ground to applicable standards, use separate PE conductors for necessary parts such as supply, motor and controller, and keep ground leads short.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 线槽与按功能分组
label.en: Installation/EMC / Cable duct and functional grouping

value.zh: 优先使用完整表面、U 形且尽可能为金属的线槽，靠角落布线并按功能分组、保持间距；间距取决于柜内区域。尽量采用双绞或按功能分组的绞合屏蔽线。图37反对电机供电、数字控制与传感器线混杂，认可分组布线。
value.en: Prefer a full-surface U-shaped, preferably metal duct, route near corners, group by function and maintain spacing according to cabinet zone. Where possible use twisted pairs or twisted/shielded functional groups. Figure 37 rejects mixed motor-supply, digital-control and sensor wiring and accepts separated groups.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 共用护套的外屏蔽及高频连接
label.en: Installation/EMC / Shared-sheath outer shield and RF connection

value.zh: 传感器线可与相线共用电缆/绝缘管，但须另有外编织屏蔽且两端连接；方案2并非总有效。如地电位偏移妨碍此连接，可用适当电容建立 RF 连接，手册举 Y1/Y2/X1/X2 为例；此时除电机端和控制器端外不要多点连接屏蔽。
value.en: Sensor and phase wires may share a cable/insulation hose with an additional outer braid connected at both ends; option 2 is not always effective. If ground offset prevents that connection, suitable capacitors may provide the RF connection, with Y1/Y2/X1/X2 given as examples; then avoid additional shield connections beyond motor and controller ends.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 接线鼻屏蔽连接工序

value.zh: 尽可能避免用接线鼻端接屏蔽；确有需要时，清除孔周氧化层，螺钉及垫圈穿过接线鼻并装锁紧垫圈，视螺钉长度将其贴于粗化表面，以底侧螺母或螺纹固定。图41区分螺钉、螺母、弹簧垫圈、平垫圈、锁紧垫圈、壁面、线鼻和保护导体。
value.en: Avoid cable-lug shield termination where possible. If necessary, remove oxide around the hole, pass the screw and washers through the lug, fit the lock washer against the roughened surface as screw length permits, and secure with a bottom nut or threaded hole. Figure 41 distinguishes screw, nut, spring washer, plain washer, lock washer, wall, wire eyelet and protective conductor.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 图42反馈频率范围的定性用途

value.zh: 按信号有用频段选择滤波措施：模拟霍尔属很低频，另区分数字霍尔/正交接口及绝对编码器。图42绘出模拟霍尔、增量编码器、数字霍尔和绝对编码器示意曲线，仅保留定性说明，不读取精确截止点。
value.en: Choose filtering by useful signal frequency: analog Hall is very low frequency, with digital Hall/quadrature and absolute encoders distinguished. Figure 42 illustrates analog Hall, incremental encoder, digital Hall and absolute encoder curves; retain qualitative guidance only, without reading exact cutoff points.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 反馈质量测量及差分线驱动
label.en: Installation/EMC / Feedback-quality measurement and differential line drivers

value.zh: 直接测量信号评估传输质量，选择正确参考电位，尽可能在控制器处测量并避免把寄生测量效应当成信号。对所述传感器系统，差分线驱动传输可提高较长电缆的抗干扰能力。
value.en: Measure signals to evaluate transmission quality, select the correct reference and measure at the controller if possible without confusing parasitic measurement effects with the signal. For the described sensor systems, differential line-driver transmission improves interference immunity over longer cables.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 图44三相同时绕制工序

value.zh: 图44先固定相线，使电机端远离操作者、插头端朝向操作者；全部三相从下方一起穿环，再顺时针返回形成绕匝，随后另加 2 匝，环内共 9 根导线通过。末步再次固定相线；图例将环上固定标为可选。
value.en: Figure 44 first secures the phase wires with the motor end away and plug end toward the operator; pass all three phases together through the ring from below, return clockwise to form a winding, then add 2 further turns, giving 9 wire passages through the ring. Secure the wires again; the legend marks fastening on the ring as optional.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 干扰来源隔离步骤

value.zh: 为确认问题是否来自驱动系统，手册建议切换输出级（电压控制模式适合此测试）、断开控制器电源或使用专用独立电源，并在有条件时关闭非必要系统部件。
value.en: To identify whether interference originates in the drive, the manual suggests switching the output stage using voltage-controller mode, disconnecting controller supplies or using a dedicated separate supply, and disabling unnecessary components where present.

label.en: Installation/EMC / Troubleshooting ground, contact and shielding checks

value.zh: 复核等电位及高频接触，使用金属对金属连接并去除油漆/绝缘层，确认屏蔽正确。选用附件目录电机线并屏蔽，必要时可双重屏蔽；检查螺接触点拧紧及插接到位。
value.en: Recheck equal potential and RF contact, use metal-to-metal connections, remove paint/insulation and verify the shield. Use shielded motor cables from the accessory catalog, optionally doubling the shield if uncertain, and check screwed contacts and plug seating.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 辐射干扰测量布置

value.zh: 辐射测量时尽可能将所有连接线铺于接地板上；屏蔽连接和未屏蔽连接线尽量短，使用 EMC 滤波器并保持其连接尽量短。
value.en: For radiated measurements place connection cables over a grounding plate where possible; keep shield connections and unshielded cables short, and use an EMC filter with the shortest practical connection.

conditions.en: Only the standard board version of the existing MC 3606 B record; its legacy name omits the interface suffix and does not select RS/CO or ET. Mode: DC motor with differential incremental encoder example. Interfaces and motor/feedback modes must match the actual configuration; optional EtherCAT functionality additionally needs an EtherCAT module, and the existing reserved AUX-DIGIO4 definition is retained. This is the manual evaluation-board wiring example: M1/M2/M3 are evaluation-board ports, not controller B2B pin numbers. The figure does not separately identify a board article; connector appearance does not extend 6500.01925 compatibility or create a combined motor/encoder/controller SKU. Existing per-pin definitions are reused, not reimported. Only edition 2 dated 2025-07-22 is transcribed; custom versions require their dedicated datasheet. This row is not an unconditional rating; old rows, IDs and winding conditions are retained.

label.zh: 图 20 / 绝对编码器信号方向

value.zh: M1 向 BL 电机输出相线；M3 向编码器供电，CS 与 CLK 的正反相信号指向电机侧，Data 的正反相信号返回控制器侧。
value.en: M1 drives the BL motor phases; M3 powers the encoder, normal/inverted CS and CLK signals point toward the motor side, and normal/inverted Data signals return toward the controller.

value.en: Size the power supply adequately; acceleration can produce current peaks up to the motor peak-current-limit setting for multiples of 10 ms.

label.en: Installation/EMC / Regenerative voltage and protection options

value.zh: 制动能量可回馈直流网络；若其他驱动不能吸收，网络电压会上升。可在控制器中设定回馈电压限值，或用额外外部制动斩波器耗散过电压。
value.en: Braking can return energy to the DC network; if other drives cannot absorb it, network voltage rises. A regenerative voltage limit can be set in the controller, or an additional external braking chopper can dissipate the overvoltage.

label.en: Installation/EMC / High-frequency interference and residential conditions

value.zh: 手册警告控制器高频干扰可能影响电子植入物或其他设备；尤其在住宅环境须采取抑制措施。即使驱动电子装置满足 EN-61800-3 Category C2 限值，也可能需要额外无线电干扰抑制。
value.en: The manual warns that controller high-frequency interference may affect electronic implants or other devices, requiring suppression especially in residential environments. Drive electronics meeting EN-61800-3 Category C2 limits may still require additional radio-interference suppression.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 图36干扰路径及符号
label.en: Installation/EMC / Figure 36 interference paths and symbols

value.zh: 图36依次示出带线路滤波的 AC/DC 电源、DC 滤波器、DC/AC 控制器、电机滤波器和电机，寄生电容支路向参考地泄放电流。Z_N 为变压器至电源连接的电网阻抗；Z_E1 为电子装置直流侧共模阻抗；Z_E2 为交流侧至电源连接共模阻抗；Z_M1 为电机壳体至控制器阻抗；I_S 为寄生电流，C_P 为寄生/滤波电容。
value.en: Figure 36 shows the line-filtered AC/DC supply, DC filter, DC/AC controller, motor filter and motor, with parasitic-capacitance paths returning current to the reference ground. Z_N is mains-transformer-to-supply impedance; Z_E1 is DC-side electronics common-mode impedance; Z_E2 is AC-side-to-supply common-mode impedance; Z_M1 is motor-housing-to-controller impedance; I_S is parasitic current and C_P parasitic/filter capacitance.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / PWM 与电源干扰来源
label.en: Installation/EMC / PWM and power-supply interference sources

value.zh: PWM 驱动的半导体、电机电缆电容成分及电机寄生元件会产生寄生电流。手册称内部 DC-DC 开关功率 <5 W，通常相关干扰较小；外部开关电源及 PWM 驱动的干扰仍取决于设计、质量与滤波效果。
value.en: PWM semiconductors, capacitive motor-cable elements and motor parasitics generate parasitic current. The manual describes internal DC-DC switched power <5 W as normally of little interference relevance; external switching-supply and PWM-drive interference still depends on design, quality and filtering.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 接地拓扑、接触与保护导体
label.en: Installation/EMC / Ground topology, contacts and protective conductors

value.zh: 接地系统宜采用星形或网状，星形较易实现；导体截面积和接触质量须兼顾高频，必要时清除端部氧化层。按适用标准接地，为电源、电机、控制器等需要的部分分别设置 PE，并尽量缩短接地线。
value.en: Prefer star or mesh grounding, with star easier to implement; conductor cross-section and contact quality must suit high frequencies, removing terminal oxide when necessary. Ground to applicable standards, use separate PE conductors for necessary parts such as supply, motor and controller, and keep ground leads short.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 线槽与按功能分组
label.en: Installation/EMC / Cable duct and functional grouping

value.zh: 优先使用完整表面、U 形且尽可能为金属的线槽，靠角落布线并按功能分组、保持间距；间距取决于柜内区域。尽量采用双绞或按功能分组的绞合屏蔽线。图37反对电机供电、数字控制与传感器线混杂，认可分组布线。
value.en: Prefer a full-surface U-shaped, preferably metal duct, route near corners, group by function and maintain spacing according to cabinet zone. Where possible use twisted pairs or twisted/shielded functional groups. Figure 37 rejects mixed motor-supply, digital-control and sensor wiring and accepts separated groups.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 接线鼻屏蔽连接工序

value.zh: 尽可能避免用接线鼻端接屏蔽；确有需要时，清除孔周氧化层，螺钉及垫圈穿过接线鼻并装锁紧垫圈，视螺钉长度将其贴于粗化表面，以底侧螺母或螺纹固定。图41区分螺钉、螺母、弹簧垫圈、平垫圈、锁紧垫圈、壁面、线鼻和保护导体。
value.en: Avoid cable-lug shield termination where possible. If necessary, remove oxide around the hole, pass the screw and washers through the lug, fit the lock washer against the roughened surface as screw length permits, and secure with a bottom nut or threaded hole. Figure 41 distinguishes screw, nut, spring washer, plain washer, lock washer, wall, wire eyelet and protective conductor.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 绝对编码器屏蔽与端接

value.zh: 绝对编码器线屏蔽两端连接；强烈建议在控制器侧靠近编码器插头的 Data+ 与 Data- 之间接 120 ohm，必要时集成于底板。也可用分裂端接替代以增强抗干扰，原文指向 AEMTL 手册 7000.0x070。
value.en: Connect the absolute-encoder shield at both ends; a 120 ohm resistor between Data+ and Data- near the controller-side encoder connector is highly recommended, integrated on the base board if necessary. Split termination is an alternative for improved immunity; the source refers to AEMTL manual 7000.0x070.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 附加输入滤波器的使用条件
label.en: Installation/EMC / When an additional input filter is needed

value.zh: 评估板已有抑制措施；附加输入滤波器 6501.00367 通常用于抗干扰要求特别高或发射明显的环境，也用于无法使用电机滤波器或其效果不足的应用。排障段另要求在信号差、已发生或预期有干扰时使用滤波措施。
value.en: The evaluation board already has suppression measures; additional input filter 6501.00367 is usually for demanding immunity or noticeable emissions, or when motor filters cannot be used or are insufficient. The troubleshooting section also calls for filtering with poor signals or actual/expected interference.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 图44三相同时绕制工序

value.zh: 图44先固定相线，使电机端远离操作者、插头端朝向操作者；全部三相从下方一起穿环，再顺时针返回形成绕匝，随后另加 2 匝，环内共 9 根导线通过。末步再次固定相线；图例将环上固定标为可选。
value.en: Figure 44 first secures the phase wires with the motor end away and plug end toward the operator; pass all three phases together through the ring from below, return clockwise to form a winding, then add 2 further turns, giving 9 wire passages through the ring. Secure the wires again; the legend marks fastening on the ring as optional.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 干扰来源隔离步骤

value.zh: 为确认问题是否来自驱动系统，手册建议切换输出级（电压控制模式适合此测试）、断开控制器电源或使用专用独立电源，并在有条件时关闭非必要系统部件。
value.en: To identify whether interference originates in the drive, the manual suggests switching the output stage using voltage-controller mode, disconnecting controller supplies or using a dedicated separate supply, and disabling unnecessary components where present.

label.zh: 安装/EMC / 排障中的接地、接触和屏蔽复核
label.en: Installation/EMC / Troubleshooting ground, contact and shielding checks

value.zh: 复核等电位及高频接触，使用金属对金属连接并去除油漆/绝缘层，确认屏蔽正确。选用附件目录电机线并屏蔽，必要时可双重屏蔽；检查螺接触点拧紧及插接到位。
value.en: Recheck equal potential and RF contact, use metal-to-metal connections, remove paint/insulation and verify the shield. Use shielded motor cables from the accessory catalog, optionally doubling the shield if uncertain, and check screwed contacts and plug seating.

value.zh: 传导测量时移除线缆环路、以往复弯曲形状布线；电机线屏蔽在电机侧及尽量靠近控制器侧连接，采用大面积、最好圆形连接；可用屏蔽夹或胶带固定电缆。

value.zh: 辐射测量时尽可能将所有连接线铺于接地板上；屏蔽连接和未屏蔽连接线尽量短，使用 EMC 滤波器并保持其连接尽量短。
value.en: For radiated measurements place connection cables over a grounding plate where possible; keep shield connections and unshielded cables short, and use an EMC filter with the shortest practical connection.

overview.zh: MC 3606 B 是 FAULHABER 的运动驱动控制器。对匹配电机进行电子换相和电流、速度或位置控制，并通过所列接口连接上位控制系统。

overview.zh: EFC 5002 S 是 FAULHABER 的驱动供电与干扰抑制组件。为匹配驱动系统处理电源或电磁干扰；需按电流、温升和布线条件集成。
overview.en: EFC 5002 S is a FAULHABER drive power and interference-suppression component. Manages power or electromagnetic interference in compatible drive systems; integration depends on current, thermal and wiring conditions.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

overview.zh: EFS 5004 S 是 FAULHABER 的驱动供电与干扰抑制组件。为匹配驱动系统处理电源或电磁干扰；需按电流、温升和布线条件集成。
overview.en: EFS 5004 S is a FAULHABER drive power and interference-suppression component. Manages power or electromagnetic interference in compatible drive systems; integration depends on current, thermal and wiring conditions.

overview.zh: MBZ 12V 是 FAULHABER 的电磁释放保持制动器。断电时以永磁力保持转轴，通电释放；仅作为保持制动器，不适用于对旋转轴作动态制动。
overview.en: MBZ 12V is a FAULHABER electromagnetically released holding brake. Holds the shaft by permanent-magnet force when unpowered and releases electrically. Intended for holding, not dynamic braking of a rotating shaft.

overview.zh: MBZ 22V 是 FAULHABER 的电磁释放保持制动器。断电时以永磁力保持转轴，通电释放；仅作为保持制动器，不适用于对旋转轴作动态制动。
overview.en: MBZ 22V is a FAULHABER electromagnetically released holding brake. Holds the shaft by permanent-magnet force when unpowered and releases electrically. Intended for holding, not dynamic braking of a rotating shaft.

overview.zh: PMB32 24V 是 FAULHABER 的电磁释放保持制动器。断电时以永磁力保持转轴，通电释放；仅作为保持制动器，不适用于对旋转轴作动态制动。
overview.en: PMB32 24V is a FAULHABER electromagnetically released holding brake. Holds the shaft by permanent-magnet force when unpowered and releases electrically. Intended for holding, not dynamic braking of a rotating shaft.

overview.zh: BC 5004 是 FAULHABER 的驱动供电与干扰抑制组件。为匹配驱动系统处理电源或电磁干扰；需按电流、温升和布线条件集成。
overview.en: BC 5004 is a FAULHABER drive power and interference-suppression component. Manages power or electromagnetic interference in compatible drive systems; integration depends on current, thermal and wiring conditions.

applications.zh: 精密运动机构、机器人和自动化设备的匹配集成
applications.en: Matched integration in precision mechanisms, robots and automation equipment

integration.zh: 按表列的绕组、级数、接口或安装条件选型；独立选件和可组合电机不被视为已经销售的组合料号。
integration.en: Select by the stated winding, stages, interface and mounting conditions. Independent options and compatible motors are not treated as sold combination part numbers.

verification.zh: 保留原表工况和原始文档定位；多配置列表及静态、峰值、选件值不冒充连续额定值。
verification.en: Retains source conditions and locators. Multiple-configuration lists, static, peak and option values are not treated as continuous ratings.

overview.zh: 1515 U 006 B 是 FAULHABER 的无刷直流减速电机。扁平无刷电机与齿轮传动集成，用于紧凑旋转执行机构；绕组电气数据和减速器输出数据分别定义。
overview.en: 1515 U 006 B is a FAULHABER brushless dc gearmotor. Integrates a flat brushless motor and gearing for compact rotary actuation. Winding electrical values and geared output values are specified separately.

overview.en: 1515 U 012 B is a FAULHABER brushless dc gearmotor. Integrates a flat brushless motor and gearing for compact rotary actuation. Winding electrical values and geared output values are specified separately.

overview.zh: 2622 S 006 B 是 FAULHABER 的无刷直流减速电机。扁平无刷电机与齿轮传动集成，用于紧凑旋转执行机构；绕组电气数据和减速器输出数据分别定义。
overview.en: 2622 S 006 B is a FAULHABER brushless dc gearmotor. Integrates a flat brushless motor and gearing for compact rotary actuation. Winding electrical values and geared output values are specified separately.

conditions.zh: 标准评估板 6500.01903，供 MC 3602 B / MC 3606 B 使用；所选控制器与电机/传感器配置必须匹配。RS232、CANopen 和 ET 功能取决于实际控制器版本，ET 另需 EtherCAT 模块。 本行模式：无刷电机。仅采用本手册的 FAULHABER 针脚编号及所示观察方向；部分编号不同于连接器制造商资料。 仅转录第 2 版（2025-07-22）的标准配置；客户定制版本按专用数据表。保留原有额定和 ID，不创建组合 SKU；本行不作为无条件数值额定。
conditions.en: Standard evaluation board 6500.01903 for MC 3602 B / MC 3606 B; the installed controller and motor/sensor configuration must match. RS232, CANopen and ET functions depend on the actual controller version; ET additionally requires an EtherCAT module. Row mode: BL motor. Use the FAULHABER pin numbers and depicted viewing orientation in this manual; some numbering differs from the connector manufacturer documentation. Only the standard configuration in edition 2 dated 2025-07-22 is transcribed; custom versions require their dedicated datasheet. Existing ratings and IDs are retained, no combined SKU is created, and this row is not an unconditional numeric rating.

Only the distance between the depicted extension lines; no board thickness, hole diameter, hole spacing or envelope including every protruding connector is inferred, and no dimension is measured from the scaled image. Source conditions are retained; this row is not an unconditional numeric rating.

overview.zh: 6501.00145 是用于匹配电机驱动系统的驱动连接适配组件，连接指定控制器、电机或反馈器件；不独立产生机械输出。
overview.en: 6501.00145 is a drive connection adapter connecting specified controllers, motors or feedback devices within a compatible drive system; it does not independently produce mechanical output.

applications.zh: 驱动器、电机和反馈接口集成
applications.en: Drive, motor and feedback interface integration

integration.zh: 电源、端子和兼容性以独立手册及连接图为准。
integration.en: Use the individual manual and connection diagram for power, terminals and compatibility.

verification.zh: 型号身份和网页公开属性已确认；网页未列出的额定电流和连接器引脚不推算。

overview.zh: IER3-1000 通过 A、B 正交通道及索引通道反馈电机转轴位移与方向。该版本采用数字方波输出。每圈线数为 1000；可安装电机受官方组合表限制。
overview.en: IER3-1000 reports motor-shaft displacement and direction through quadrature A/B and index channels. This version provides digital square-wave outputs. Resolution is 1000 lines per revolution; compatible motors follow the official combination table.

overview.zh: IER3-1024 通过 A、B 正交通道及索引通道反馈电机转轴位移与方向。该版本采用数字方波输出。每圈线数为 1024；可安装电机受官方组合表限制。
overview.en: IER3-1024 reports motor-shaft displacement and direction through quadrature A/B and index channels. This version provides digital square-wave outputs. Resolution is 1024 lines per revolution; compatible motors follow the official combination table.

applications.zh: 机器人精密驱动的接口集成
applications.en: Interface integration for precision robot drives

integration.zh: 依照适配对象和逐端口引脚定义连接；同名信号的反相通道必须区分。
integration.en: Connect according to compatibility and individual port pin assignments; inverted channels must be distinguished.

verification.zh: 不从适配器型号推算电机功率和连续输出。
verification.en: Adapter identity does not establish motor power or continuous output.

overview.zh: IER3-1700 通过 A、B 正交通道及索引通道反馈电机转轴位移与方向。该版本采用数字方波输出。每圈线数为 1700；可安装电机受官方组合表限制。
overview.en: IER3-1700 reports motor-shaft displacement and direction through quadrature A/B and index channels. This version provides digital square-wave outputs. Resolution is 1700 lines per revolution; compatible motors follow the official combination table.

applications.zh: 机器人精密驱动的接口集成

integration.zh: 依照适配对象和逐端口引脚定义连接；同名信号的反相通道必须区分。
integration.en: Connect according to compatibility and individual port pin assignments; inverted channels must be distinguished.

verification.zh: 不从适配器型号推算电机功率和连续输出。
verification.en: Adapter identity does not establish motor power or continuous output.

overview.zh: IER3-10000 通过 A、B 正交通道及索引通道反馈电机转轴位移与方向。该版本采用数字方波输出。每圈线数为 10000；可安装电机受官方组合表限制。
overview.en: IER3-10000 reports motor-shaft displacement and direction through quadrature A/B and index channels. This version provides digital square-wave outputs. Resolution is 10000 lines per revolution; compatible motors follow the official combination table.

overview.zh: IER3-2048 L 通过 A、B 正交通道及索引通道反馈电机转轴位移与方向。L 版本提供 TIA-422 兼容的差分输出。每圈线数为 2048；可安装电机受官方组合表限制。
overview.en: IER3-2048 L reports motor-shaft displacement and direction through quadrature A/B and index channels. The L version provides TIA-422-compatible differential outputs. Resolution is 2048 lines per revolution; compatible motors follow the official combination table.

applications.zh: 机器人精密驱动的接口集成

integration.zh: 依照适配对象和逐端口引脚定义连接；同名信号的反相通道必须区分。
integration.en: Connect according to compatibility and individual port pin assignments; inverted channels must be distinguished.

verification.zh: 不从适配器型号推算电机功率和连续输出。
verification.en: Adapter identity does not establish motor power or continuous output.

overview.zh: IER3-10000 L 通过 A、B 正交通道及索引通道反馈电机转轴位移与方向。L 版本提供 TIA-422 兼容的差分输出。每圈线数为 10000；可安装电机受官方组合表限制。
overview.en: IER3-10000 L reports motor-shaft displacement and direction through quadrature A/B and index channels. The L version provides TIA-422-compatible differential outputs. Resolution is 10000 lines per revolution; compatible motors follow the official combination table.

integration.en: Connect according to compatibility and individual port pin assignments; inverted channels must be distinguished.

verification.zh: 不从适配器型号推算电机功率和连续输出。
verification.en: Adapter identity does not establish motor power or continuous output.
